title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and allocation paragraph
claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the allocation using the supplied JSON body.
claims.quote:
$apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
$apiVersion = "2024-10-01"
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: The JSON body supplies scope.environmentId and an MCSMessages allocation quantity with enforcementRules containing TenantPool enabled false.
claims.quote: scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... enforcementRules = @( ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }

claims.claim: The allocation request requires authenticated authorisation.
claims.quote:
$auth = Get-MsalToken -ClientId $clientId -TenantId $tenantId -Scope "https://api.powerplatform.com/.default" -Interactive
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $($auth.AccessToken)" }

claims.claim: The documented allocation request sends Content-Type application/json.
claims.quote: -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: Disabling the TenantPool enforcement rule turns off drawing from unallocated tenant capacity.
claims.quote: The Draw from the available capacity in my tenant option in the admin center maps to the TenantPool enforcement rule

claims.claim: Eligible Copilot Studio environments without allocation configuration have tenant-capacity draw selected by default.
claims.quote: For eligible Copilot Studio environments, Draw from the available capacity in my tenant is selected by default when no allocation configuration exists.

claims.claim: A published environment-group tenant-draw rule makes the environment-level setting read-only.
claims.quote: When you publish a rule, it governs every environment in the group. The environment-level setting becomes read-only in the Power Platform admin center

claims.claim: Programmatic requests cannot override a published environment-group tenant-draw rule.
claims.quote: Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio, review the Agent flow actions used by each workflow.
